description: For an elementary embedding \(h:M\to N\), transporting the structure of \(N\) onto \(M\sqcup(N\setminus h(M))\) along the copy bijection makes the specified first-summand inclusion of \(M\) elementary.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.elementary_copy_inclusion.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  {N : Type w'} [L.Structure M] [L.Structure N] (h : L.ElementaryEmbedding M N) : ∃ j, ⇑j = Sum.inl
